Humans basically need to learn coping skills. We are panicky animals by nature. Unfortunately, many of don't find out until we are adults that our coping skills are lacking.

Maybe we are putting too much effort in to relationship that isn't in our power to fix or maybe we aren't putting in enough effort to get the job we want. Never lie to yourself so you can embrace the truth of situations.

Second, accept when you fucked shit up and so you can move on. Sometimes situations may get beyond repair. Yes there will be consequences but the longer you wait, the worse those consequences will be. Failure is only bad when you haven't learned anything from it.

I know these simple words are hard to follow but no matter what. Never let yourself become paralyzed by your emotion. You can't change how you feel but you can change how you react to those feelings.
